doc: Every module constant of climate.py (Earth anchors, Hadley and storm-track bounds, deformation fraction, map texel and width cap) and the field defaults of flow.Flow (jet, trades, polar_easterlies) and flow.Vortex (age), in params.names order: a tripwire for a port whose constants drifted. The literals inside the functions (0.15, 0.85, 1e-3, ...) are not constants: the port reads them from the source. Exact. A pseudo-function name: there is nothing to call, the port maps it by hand.
